name: Deprecated TLS/SSL protocol enabled (SSLv2/SSLv3/TLSv1.0/TLSv1.1)
attack_scenario: A network MITM forces the handshake to negotiate TLS 1.0/SSLv3 and uses POODLE/BEAST to decrypt session cookies or injected plaintext byte-by-byte.
negative_test_hint: configure ssl_protocols with "TLSv1 TLSv1.1" and assert the server refuses handshakes below TLS 1.2

exemplar.explanation: SSLv2/SSLv3 (POODLE) and TLS 1.0/1.1 (BEAST, weak MACs, deprecated per RFC 8996) carry protocol-level cryptographic weaknesses, and enabling them lets a man-in-the-middle downgrade the handshake to a broken protocol. Restricting ssl_protocols to TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 removes the downgrade path.
